global.explain: Bytes InnoDB read from its data files (Innodb_data_read).
global.label: Data read

global.explain: Bytes InnoDB wrote (Innodb_data_written). On MariaDB redo log writes are not included; see Redo written.
global.label: Data written

global.explain: Read operations on InnoDB data files (Innodb_data_reads); one can read several pages.
global.label: Read operations

global.explain: Buffer pool pages read from disk (Innodb_buffer_pool_reads, read-ahead included on MariaDB).
global.label: Pages read from disk

notes: Performance Schema is off, so per-table and per-file I/O cannot be read. MariaDB ships with it off. To turn it on, add performance_schema=ON under [mysqld] in my.cnf and restart the server (it cannot be changed at runtime). It then uses some memory and a little CPU. Or turn on user statistics with SET GLOBAL userstat = ON (runtime, small overhead on every statement) for rows read and changed per table.
